situation: An engineer started a full postmortem for a three-minute, low-impact blip.
decision: Do a half-page review focused on what changed before each recurrence, and escalate only if a common cause appears.

moves.name: size review to blast radius and reversibility
moves.step: Scale the review effort to how many were hurt and whether the harm could be undone.
moves.evidence: not every incident gets the same size of review

moves.name: treat three small events as a pattern
moves.step: Look harder at a trivial event when it has recurred.
moves.cue: the third occurrence of a similar blip
moves.evidence: One small blip is noise; three is a pattern.

moves.name: check what changed before each event
moves.step: Compare the changes that preceded each occurrence to find a common cause.
moves.evidence: what changed before each of the three?

considerations.evidence: would cost the team more than the incident did
